Accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
Accessibility.intro: Land of Jesus is committed to making this website usable by everyone, including people with disabilities, in line with Israel’s Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities Law (1998) and Standard IS 5568, and with the European Accessibility Act.
Accessibility.conformanceBody: This website aims to conform to WCAG 2.1 Level AA. It was last reviewed on {date}; the next review is planned for {nextDate}.
Accessibility.feature1: A “skip to content” link at the top of every page.
Accessibility.feature2: A clear heading structure and one main heading per page.
Accessibility.feature3: Alt text on meaningful images; decorative images are marked as decorative.
Accessibility.feature4: Full keyboard operation, including the menu, the language picker and the map.
Accessibility.feature5: Visible focus outlines on every interactive element.
Accessibility.feature6: Text contrast of at least 4.5 to 1 against its background.
Accessibility.feature7: The correct reading direction for every language, including right-to-left.
Accessibility.feature8: Motion and animation are turned off when your device asks for reduced motion.
Accessibility.feature9: Large touch targets and a layout that reflows without sideways scrolling.
Accessibility.limitationsBody: The interactive map is a third-party component; a full text list of every site is always shown beside it. We know of no other limitations at this time.
Accessibility.contactResponse: We aim to reply within five business days.
Accessibility.reportBody: If you meet any accessibility barrier on this website, please email us and describe the page or feature, the assistive technology you use, if any, and the problem. We will look into it and reply within five business days.
Accessibility.improvementBody: We review the accessibility of this website every year and make improvements as we go. Your feedback helps us do better for everyone.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how the Land of Jesus website treats your information. In short: we run no analytics, we use no advertising or tracking, we have no user accounts, and we never sell your data. This page is general information, not legal advice.
Privacy.controllerBody: The Land of Jesus website ({site}) is operated by {name}, who acts as the data controller. You can reach us at {email}. This policy is written to align with Israel’s Protection of Privacy Law, 5741-1981 and its Amendment 13, and with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the ePrivacy rules.
Privacy.collectBody: We do not ask you to create an account, and there is no contact form on this site. We handle only: (1) basic technical data that any website receives — such as your IP address, browser type and the pages you open — recorded briefly in our hosting provider’s server logs to keep the site secure and working; and (2) if you choose to email us, the email address and message you send.
Privacy.noTrackingBody: We do not use Google Analytics or any other analytics service, we run no advertising, we place no tracking or marketing cookies, and we do not build profiles of visitors or make automated decisions about you. We do not sell or rent your personal data to anyone.
Privacy.cookiesBody: We use only essential cookies needed for the site to function — for example to remember your chosen language and to keep a secure session. We set no analytics or advertising cookies, so no tracking consent is required. You can block or delete cookies in your browser at any time and the site will still work.
Privacy.thirdPartyBody: We rely on a few providers who process data only to run the site: Vercel (website hosting and delivery, United States), Supabase (content database), and OpenFreeMap (map tiles — when you open the interactive map, your browser requests map images from OpenFreeMap, which necessarily receives your IP address). If you email us, your message is handled by our email provider. None of these use your data for their own advertising.
Privacy.transfersBody: Some of our providers are based in, or store data in, the United States and other countries. Where personal data leaves your region, it is protected by appropriate safeguards such as the European Commission’s Standard Contractual Clauses.
Privacy.retentionBody: Server logs that contain IP addresses are kept only briefly — typically up to 90 days — and then deleted. Emails you send us are kept only as long as needed to answer you and for our records, and are deleted on request.
Privacy.legalBasisBody: Under the GDPR we rely on our legitimate interest in keeping the website secure, available and functioning — for technical server logs and essential cookies — and on your consent where you voluntarily contact us. You may object to processing based on legitimate interest at any time.
Privacy.rightsBody: You have the right to ask what personal data we hold about you and to receive a copy, to correct it, to delete it, to restrict or object to its use, to data portability, and to withdraw any consent. To exercise any of these, email {email} with the subject “Privacy Rights Request.” We will respond within 30 days.
Privacy.complaintsBody: If you believe we have mishandled your data, you may complain to a regulator. In Israel: the Privacy Protection Authority (PPA), 66 Kanfei Nesharim St., Jerusalem. In the EU/EEA: your national data protection supervisory authority. We would appreciate the chance to address your concern first.
Privacy.childrenBody: This website is intended for a general audience and is not directed at children. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If you believe a child has sent us personal data, please contact us and we will delete it.
Privacy.securityBody: The site is served entirely over encrypted HTTPS connections, and access to any stored data is restricted. If a data breach ever affected your rights, we would notify the relevant authority and any affected people as required by law, without undue delay.
Privacy.changesBody: We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top shows when it was last changed; where changes are significant, we will make them clear on this page.
Privacy.contactBody: For any question about this policy or your privacy, email us at {email}.

Cookie.title: Cookie Policy
Cookie.noticeText: This site uses only essential cookies to work properly — no tracking, no advertising.
Cookie.intro: This Cookie Policy explains how the Land of Jesus website uses cookies. It is simple: we use only the few cookies the site needs to work, and none for analytics, advertising or tracking.
Cookie.whatBody: Cookies are small text files a website stores in your browser so it can remember basic things between pages, such as the language you chose.
Cookie.weUseBody: We use only strictly necessary cookies: one that remembers the language you selected, and a secure session cookie that lets pages load correctly. These are required for the site to work and cannot meaningfully be turned off.
Cookie.noTrackingBody: We set no analytics cookies, no advertising cookies, no social-media pixels and no cross-site tracking. We do not profile you and we do not sell your data.
Cookie.thirdPartyBody: When you open the interactive map, your browser loads map images from OpenFreeMap, which may receive your IP address. This is an ordinary network request, not a cookie, and no tracking cookie is set.
Cookie.controlBody: You can block or delete cookies at any time in your browser settings. Because we use only essential cookies, the site will still work — you may simply need to choose your language again.
Cookie.changesBody: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time. The date at the top shows when it last changed.
Cookie.contactBody: For any question about cookies, email us at {email}.

Some imagery is public-domain sacred art. Please credit the site when you share its content, and do not present it as your own or use it commercially without our permission.
Terms.projectsBody: Project pages and any funding figures are shown for information only. They are not an offer, a contract, or a request for payment, and their inclusion does not guarantee any particular outcome.
Terms.externalBody: The site may link to third-party websites and services, such as maps. We do not control them and are not responsible for their content, accuracy or privacy practices.
Terms.accuracyBody: Content is offered in good faith for general information. Historical, religious and practical details — such as opening hours — can change and may contain errors, so please verify anything important before relying on it.
Terms.warrantyBody: The website and its content are provided “as is” and “as available”, without warranties of any kind, whether express or implied, to the extent permitted by law.
Terms.liabilityBody: To the fullest extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any loss or damage arising from your use of, or inability to use, this website. Nothing here limits any rights you have that cannot be limited by law.

Terms.lawBody: These Terms are governed by the laws of the State of Israel. This does not remove any mandatory consumer protections you have under the law of your own country of residence.

Disclaimer.generalBody: All content on this site is provided for general information and educational purposes. It is not professional, legal, religious or travel advice, and should not be relied upon as such.
Disclaimer.accuracyBody: We work to keep the information correct and up to date, but we make no guarantee that it is complete, current or free of error. Details such as opening hours, access and project status can change without notice.
Disclaimer.religiousBody: Descriptions of churches, traditions and history are presented respectfully for heritage and educational purposes and reflect widely held accounts. They are not an official statement of any church, denomination or authority.
Disclaimer.imageryBody: Some images are public-domain works of sacred art shown for illustration. They are not necessarily photographs of the present-day sites unless stated.
Disclaimer.translationBody: This site is offered in many languages, and translations may be produced with the help of automated tools. If there is any discrepancy, the English version prevails.
Disclaimer.externalBody: Links to third-party websites are provided for convenience only. We do not endorse them and are not responsible for their content or practices.
Disclaimer.travelBody: Before you travel, always confirm current opening times, access and local conditions with official sources. We are not responsible for decisions made based on the information here.
Disclaimer.contactBody: For any question about this disclaimer, email us at {email}.
